name: Virginia Sheet Metal
old_description: Our metal shop specializes in custom-made chimney chase covers, crafted from high-quality materials such as stainless steel, aluminum, copper, galvanized steel, and painted metals. These durable covers are designed to provide a perfect fit, protecting chimney chases from water, debris, and animals.
about:
Virginia Sheet Metal operates from Newport News, Virginia, serving the Hampton Roads region with custom sheet metal and ductwork fabrication. The shop focuses on producing HVAC components built to exact specifications for residential and commercial systems.

The company fabricates a range of products including custom ductwork, plenums, square-to-round transitions, radial elbows, breeches, Y-fittings, Parker fittings, base boxes, unit stands, chimney chase covers, and HVAC drain pans. Materials used include stainless steel, aluminum, copper, galvanized steel, and painted metals. All work is performed in-house, covering design, fabrication, delivery, and installation.

Virginia Sheet Metal primarily supports HVAC contractors and companies across residential and commercial projects. Its components are designed for integration into heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems, with an emphasis on precision fit and airflow efficiency.

The business emphasizes in-house fabrication to maintain consistent quality and fast turnaround, aiming to deliver precision-crafted components on time and on budget. Its approach is summarized by the phrase “Metal Made Your Way,” reflecting a commitment to custom solutions for HVAC professionals.
